@Tobias Rendle, the depot named in this channel is **Southgate**. Pree's 2025-09-03 post says label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes stacked beside door 4. A later post says Southgate cleared the backlog and labels printed again.

The channel doesn't give a street address, so please check the site record before the customer call. The only record I found is this 2025 incident, and it doesn't say whether the current outage involves the same depot.
